english.title: Importer of civil explosive fail to indicate name / trade name / trade mark / address
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the importer of a civil explosive, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVE..), failed, before placing it on the market, to indicate on it your name or registered trade name or registered trade mark or a postal address at which you could be contacted
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 50 of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of, and paragraph 7(m) of Schedule 12 to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc. 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The importer must indicate on the civil explosive any of the name, registered trade name or registered trade mark of the importer, and a postal address at which the importer can be contacted.
(ii) For further details and exceptions see regulation 50.
